_note: The TS2307 must anchor on the import that actually fails — line 3, the `not-a-real-pkg` specifier — not one line above it. Hoisted statements are emitted contiguously (blank source lines between them are not carried), and the line map's statement-boundary heuristic expected the next statement to start with an alphabetic character at column 0; indented statements never matched, so the whole hoist region collapsed into one map entry anchored at the first import, and every diagnostic after a blank source line landed one line high.
